_source: docs/design-bible.md: Quantum Basalts and permanent upgrades, plus Build clarifications 2, 9 and 11.
_scopes: personal = only its owner benefits. party-per-owner = shared, and every owner in the party adds more. party-highest = shared, the highest rank in the party applies.

upgrades.name: Starting Boon
upgrades.effect: At the start of floor 1, room 1, roll a random boon at Level 1. Banish and Reroll apply to it.

upgrades.name: Forge
upgrades.effect: Unlocks a Forge in post-boss rooms. One use per owner in the party, then it cools.

upgrades.name: Healing Font
upgrades.effect: Unlocks a Healing Font in post-boss rooms. Each owner beyond the first adds temp HP for everyone.

upgrades.name: Extra Boon Slot
upgrades.effect: A 4th boon slot at rank 1 and a 5th at rank 2.

upgrades.name: Reroll
upgrades.effect: Reroll your boon offer 1, 2, then 3 times per floor.

upgrades.name: Extra Loot
upgrades.effect: +10% to your own boss Quantum Basalts per rank.

upgrades.name: Extra Pressures
upgrades.effect: Rank 1 unlocks Restless Stone and Heavy Crown; rank 2 unlocks the harsher versions. Every owner in the party adds +5% to rewards.

upgrades.name: Reprieve
upgrades.effect: A 20%, 35%, 50%, then 65% chance of a Reprieve room mid-floor. Every owner rolls separately.

upgrades.name: Attunement
upgrades.effect: Your first offer of each run includes a tag you choose.

upgrades.name: Banish
upgrades.effect: Remove 1, 2, then 3 boons from your personal offers.

upgrades.name: Hidden Sight
upgrades.effect: One hint per floor about a room's secret condition.

upgrades.name: Deep Pockets
upgrades.effect: +5% loot kept on extraction per rank, up to 100%. The highest rank in the party applies.

upgrades.name: Quick Return
upgrades.effect: Shorten your death lockout by 1 day per rank, to a minimum of 1 day.
